profiles.label: CPU only
profiles.generator: Qwen3.5-4B Q4_K_M or Q5_K_M through your Ollama or llama.cpp server. Answers are slow; keep them short.
profiles.embed_rerank: Granite embedding and the ModernBERT reranker on CPU, inside Exculpata.
profiles.asr: faster-whisper small or medium, int8, or skip transcription.
profiles.tradeoff: Search and source review keep working. Generated answers are the slowest tier and are easier to mis-ground. This is a suggestion, not a measured quality result.

profiles.label: CPU only, 16 GB RAM and up
profiles.generator: Qwen3.5-4B Q4_K_M or Q5_K_M through your Ollama or llama.cpp server. Answers are slow; keep them short.
profiles.embed_rerank: Granite embedding and the ModernBERT reranker on CPU, inside Exculpata.
profiles.asr: faster-whisper small or medium, int8, or skip transcription.
profiles.tradeoff: A 16 GB machine can hold a 4B quantized model beside the application. Answers are still slow. Firmware often reserves part of installed RAM, so 14 GiB of reported memory matches this tier. This is a suggestion, not a measured quality result.

profiles.label: 8 GB GPU
profiles.generator: Qwen3.5-4B Q5 or Q8, or Qwen3.5-9B Q4 with partial offload, through Ollama or llama.cpp.
profiles.embed_rerank: Granite embedding and the ModernBERT reranker on CPU or GPU, inside Exculpata.
profiles.tradeoff: A 4B model leaves more room and answers faster. A 9B Q4 model may place some layers in system RAM and run slower. This is a suggestion, not a measured quality result.

profiles.label: 12 GB GPU
profiles.generator: Qwen3.5-9B Q4_K_M through Q6, through Ollama or llama.cpp.
profiles.embed_rerank: Granite embedding and the ModernBERT reranker on GPU, inside Exculpata.
profiles.tradeoff: A quantized 9B model fits more comfortably than the full-precision bundled profile. Keep the KV cache at 8-bit or higher. This is a suggestion, not a measured quality result.

profiles.label: 16 GB GPU
profiles.generator: Qwen3.5-9B Q6, or the bundled vLLM Qwen3.5-9B profile when the installer accepts the card.
profiles.embed_rerank: Granite embedding and the ModernBERT reranker on GPU, inside Exculpata.
profiles.asr: faster-whisper large-v3, float16 when the card has room.
profiles.tradeoff: 16 GB is enough for a quantized 9B model. The bundled full-precision profile still has to pass the installer's existing free-VRAM check. This is a suggestion, not a measured quality result.

profiles.label: 24 GB GPU and up
profiles.generator: Qwen3.5-9B through the bundled vLLM service. This is the current reference profile.
profiles.embed_rerank: Granite embedding and the ModernBERT reranker on GPU, inside Exculpata.
profiles.tradeoff: This matches the bundled generator. It is the reference deployment shape, not a published accuracy score.

profiles.label: Apple Silicon, 16 GB unified memory and up
profiles.generator: Qwen3.5-4B or Qwen3.5-9B through Ollama on Metal. MLX is not part of this version.
profiles.embed_rerank: Granite embedding and the ModernBERT reranker on CPU, inside Exculpata.
profiles.asr: faster-whisper on CPU, int8. whisper.cpp is not part of this version.
profiles.tradeoff: Unified memory is shared with the rest of the machine. A 4B model leaves more room than 9B. This is a suggestion, not a measured quality result.
